newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares end weaker as cautious mood prevails.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares end weaker as cautious mood prevails.

text.p: 1535 GMT - Dutch shares end with mild losses despite a strong early start. Investors remaining cautious after Friday's shake-out and profit-taking setting in at the highs. Weaker bond market hitting financials first, spreading jitters to the rest of the market. Most heavyweights end lower, Royal Dutch under pressure from declining oil price. BolsWessanen holding gains on continued takeover speculation despite company denials. Small caps Getronics, which bought rest of RAET and ASM Lithography which subject of broker recommendation also ended firm.
*AEX closed down 1.57 points at 622.33. BolsWessanen up 2.00 guilders at 32.00, Getronics 2.90 up at 46.00 guilders.
